title: waitForLoadState() after a click returns immediately and the next step runs on the old page
symptoms: Assertions after click() plus waitForLoadState() read the previous page
Flaky failures that disappear when a fixed wait is added
cause: waitForLoadState checks the document that is current when it is called. If the navigation has not committed yet, the old page already counts as loaded, so it resolves at once.
fix: Wait for the destination itself with waitForURL or a web-first assertion on the new page.
apply:
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save' }).click()
await page.waitForURL('**/orders/*')
await expect(page.getByText('Order saved')).toBeVisible()
